description: This file defines the Pattern struct and related functions for matching and processing HTTP request path patterns in gRPC Gateway runtime, including pattern creation, matching, and unescaping logic.

classes.name: Pattern
classes.description: A template pattern for matching HTTP request paths, supporting operations like push, capture, and concatenation, with methods for pattern matching and string representation.

methods.name: NewPattern
methods.description: Creates a new Pattern instance from given op codes, pool, and verb, validating the pattern structure.

methods.name: MustPattern
methods.description: Helper to create a Pattern, terminating the program if creation fails.

methods.name: MatchAndEscape
methods.description: Matches components against the pattern, returning variable bindings if successful, with support for unescaping modes.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Deprecated method for matching components without per-component unescaping.

methods.name: Verb
methods.description: Returns the verb part of the pattern.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the pattern.
